verdict.rationale: Browser Use ships an open-source Python library explicitly positioned for local, code-driven automation ('For a local agent, use the open-source library'; 'automate the web at scale, from your own code, and with any LLM'), and community reports confirm running it locally against a real local Chrome browser/profile without a cloud account. missing for 10: no explicit walkthrough showing zero network/account calls during local runs, and no independent benchmark of purely offline/local operation.
